subject.title: fix(synology-chat): handle HEAD probe and return 200 on webhook ACK

question: Should OpenClaw accept a tokenless 200 response for Synology Chat HEAD liveness probes while keeping POST authentication and throttling unchanged?
rationale: The source fix is narrow, but automation cannot confirm Synology's live HEAD behavior or make the security-boundary call for unauthenticated liveness responses.

options.title: Refresh With Proof
options.body: Require a rebase or replacement on current main plus redacted Synology logs or terminal output showing HEAD success, POST 200 {"success":true}, and continued delivery.

options.title: Adopt The Patch
options.body: A maintainer can carry the narrow fix forward if they can supply equivalent real Synology proof and explicitly accept the HEAD liveness boundary.

options.title: Pause The PR
options.body: Leave this PR blocked or close it only if the canonical issue remains open for a fresh proof-backed implementation.

recommendation.title: Refresh With Proof
recommendation.body: Require a rebase or replacement on current main plus redacted Synology logs or terminal output showing HEAD success, POST 200 {"success":true}, and continued delivery.
